messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have looked at your request carefully for our shop. We can offer you a price of €36.00 per unit. 

We always aim to deliver top quality from our machines for your orders, and we look forward to working together on this project. Let us know if this works for you.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding rfq: pump shaft for the new hx series.
We hold a competing offer at 31.50 EUR per unit (offer:70240-0).
Your rolling quality to 2026Q3 stands at 1863 ppm (sc:70210@2026Q3).
Electric power generation producer prices (PPI-D351) changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
We can work with your lead time of 28 days.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,200 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

We don't do detailed cost breakdowns here, it's just machine hours and material. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our offer at our standard terms is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. 

You offered to pay faster, which helps my cash flow, so I set the payment terms to 14 days. Alternatively, with a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (2)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We did not know that - a fair point. I am the owner here, so I make the decisions on pricing directly. 

Our current offer is a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

Since you offered to pay faster and we need the cash, I changed the payment to 14 days. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €28.00 per unit.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (3)
messages.body:
Hallo,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We quote a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

The volume change figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. You talk about a binding volume of 4,200 pcs, but the forecast data you cited does not exist. Please send me the actual proof for this volume. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
